==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Needed|[[Ghostspeak amulet]]}}
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Drezel]] to get three [[meat pie]]s and three [[apple pie]]s. {{Chat option|1Well, what is it, I may be able to help?|1Yes.|4I'd better get going.}}
*Leave the temple and run south through [[Mort Myre Swamp]] to the [[Nature Grotto]] north-west of [[Mort'ton]].  Note: You must enter Mort Myre through the gate, or Filliman will not appear. 
*Attempt to enter the grotto and [[Filliman]] will come out. Wear your [[amulet of ghostspeak]] and talk to him. {{Chat option|2How long have you been a ghost?}}. Note that Filliman will disappear after a while so you need to be actively interacting with him.
*Take the [[washing bowl]] off the nearby [[bench (Nature Grotto)|bench]] to find a [[mirror]] underneath.
*Use the mirror on Filliman, he then tells you to find his [[Journal (Filliman Tarlock)|journal]]. If using does not work, try talking him again, it should do the trick.
*Search (right-click) the grotto tree to get his journal then use it on him to give it to him. {{Chat option|4How can I help?}} He'll give you a [[druidic spell]].}}

===The Nature Spirit===
{{Needed|[[Silver sickle]], [[Ghostspeak amulet]]}}
{{Checklist|*Run back to [[Drezel]] and ask him to bless you.
**UIM Note: If you discarded your [[Wolfbane]], you will first have to take the replacement dagger and then speak to him to be blessed.
*Enter the swamp, stand next to a rotting log in the swamp and cast the druidic spell.
*Quickly pick a mushroom growing from the log and bring it back to Filliman's camp.
* Talk to Filliman to ensure he is standing outside between all 3 stones.
*Use the mushroom on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Brown|light-brown stone]].
*Use the used spell card on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Grey|grey stone]].
*Stand on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Orange|orange stone]] and tell Filliman you've solved the puzzle. {{Chat option|3I think I've solved the puzzle!}}
*Enter the hole under the tree then search the grotto in the middle of the cave.
*Give the nature spirit your [[silver sickle]] by talking to him and he will give you a [[druid pouch]].}}

===Killing the Ghasts===
{{Checklist|*Leave the grotto and stand next to rotting plants (logs, bushes, branches) in the swamp.
*Using the [[silver sickle (b)]]'s [[Bloom]] ability (requires prayer points), harvest the swamp plants and fill your druid pouch with them.
*Use your filled druid pouch on [[Ghast]]s to make them attackable, kill three of them.
*Return to the nature spirit by clicking the grotto in the cave and he'll redecorate the grotto.
**If you plan on completing the [[Morytania Diary]], pray at the altar now.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
